unsupported.statusLine: Codex has no plugin status line; run jevris status.
unsupported.PermissionRequest: Never registered: native approval stays authoritative.
unsupported.toolFailureEvidence: A Bash or apply_patch PostToolUse carries only the output text, with no exit status (Codex source at rust-v0.157.1), so a failed shell command is recorded as finished; failure evidence comes only from an MCP result with isError.
unsupported.hookTrust: Codex keeps its /hooks trust decisions to itself, so doctor cannot read them; run /hooks in Codex to review and trust the Jevris hooks.
unsupported.subagents: Jevris makes no permission decision in a subagent, so Codex's approval policy, which a subagent shares with its parent, governs it, and the verification gate holds only the parent's Stop, never SubagentStop. A subagent's hooks are recorded under the parent session; an agent role that turns plugins off runs without Jevris.
unsupported.access.session: No Codex hook carries a failed turn's error, so an interactive session's access limit is not detected; an owned Codex run's limit is, through access.detect.

compatibility.basis: Codex 0.x ships a minor about weekly with features, and patches as fixes: 0.157.0 on 2026-09-25, then 0.157.1 on 2026-09-26 (github.com/openai/codex/releases, read 2026-09-26). Each new minor is re-checked in the background with no model call.
